name: Incline Cable Overhead Extension (Away from Stack)
description: An overhead extension on an incline bench positioned away from the cable stack. This angle provides a unique long-head stretch position. The cable maintains constant tension through the eccentric, which is valuable for tricep hypertrophy.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Incline Cable Overhead Extension (Away from Stack) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Incline Cable Overhead Extension (Away from Stack).
steps: Step 1: Set incline bench facing away from low pulley. Lie back and hold cable handle overhead.
Step 2: Keep elbows pointing toward ceiling with upper arms by ears.
Step 3: Lower handle behind head until triceps are fully stretched.
Step 4: Extend elbows to full lockout overhead.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Feel the stretch at the bottom
